zoe (People Ops): Quick alignment: review forms open Mon 2024-06-03 08:00 PT. Managers please schedule 1:1s for signoff week.
dave (Eng Manager): If a signoff coincides with sprint demos, any guidance?
zoe (People Ops): Prioritize signoffs. If demo is high visibility, move demo or ask for a delegate. We can't extend post-freeze deadlines except in exceptional LOA cases.
nia (IC): Are self-assessments mandatory for ICs hired within 30 days?
zoe (People Ops): New joiners (<=30 days) fill a short starter self-assessment; it's required to capture ramp context. Use the "new-joiner" checkbox in the form.
kal (Product): Can we attach product metrics dashboards? Some folks rely on GA4 dashboards that are behind perms.
zoe (People Ops): Links ok but set "view" for people-ops and your manager. Prefer a short screenshot embedded in a doc + link.
ops-bot: Automated reminder: manager signoff countdown = 6 days.
dave (Eng Manager): For calibration, do we still bring pay-band recommendations?
zoe (People Ops): Dont include pay numbers in the packet. Bring level/promotion asks and evidence. Compensation notes are separate and handled by total rewards after calibration.
nia (IC): Is there an internal deadline for managers to upload peer feedback docs?
zoe (People Ops): Yes 2024-06-07 17:00 PT. Missing attachments will delay calibration placement.
dave (Eng Manager): If one of my reviewers is OOO, can I ask for a proxy reviewer?
zoe (People Ops): Yes. Submit a proxy request via the exceptions form with the proxys name; People Ops approves and updates the reviewer column.
kal (Product): Small ask: can People Ops add a "notes for skip-level" column in the tracker?
zoe (People Ops): Done. Added column and sample copy. Use it sparingly.
ops-bot: Export link: s3://people-ops/reports/review_cycle_jun/summary.csv
dave (Eng Manager): Thanks. One last Q: after calibration, how long before comp letters go out?
zoe (People Ops): Comp letters for approved promotions go out within 10 business days post-calibration once comp completes processing.
nia (IC): Cool. Thanks all :wave:
